## Locality Guide: Barsebäck Parish, Harjager, Malmöhus, Sweden — c. 1680–1740

### Jurisdictional context
Barsebäck is a Lutheran parish in Harjager hundred (härad), Malmöhus County, Scania (Skåne) — southernmost Sweden. Standard historical place: **Barsebäck, Harjager, Malmöhus, Sweden** (1648–1996). Skåne was under Danish rule until the Treaty of Roskilde (1658); by 1680 the Church of Sweden held full administrative control. Records flow through the Landsarkivet i Lund (Regional Archives of Lund), now part of Riksarkivet.

### Primary record types

**Dopbok/Födelsebok (baptism register):** Lists baptism date, child, father, mother, godparents. FamilySearch collection 1974200 (browse-only, imageGroupPrefix 004514823, 749 images, covers 1648–1861). Also indexed cross-collection: 'Sweden, Baptisms, 1611–1920' (coll. 1520594, 7M+ records).

**Husförhörslängd (household examination roll):** Annual clergy survey of each household; records names, birth years, birthplaces, moves. Highest-value source for Elena's birth parish. FamilySearch imageGroupPrefix 004514824 (543 images, covers Barsebäck + Hofterup 1696–1729) — browse-only.

**Vigselbok (marriage register):** Records Elena's marriage to Jöns Jönsson, naming her father and home parish. FamilySearch 'Sweden, Marriages, 1630–1920' (coll. 1520596, 1.7M indexed).

**Begravningsbok/Dödbok (burial/death):** May record Elena's death with age and birthplace. FamilySearch 'Sweden, Burials, 1649–1920' (coll. 1520597, 1.16M indexed).

**Inflyttnings-/Utflyttningslängd (migration records):** If Elena moved into Barsebäck from another parish, an entry names her origin parish — directly answering the birthplace question.

### Access
- FamilySearch (free, login): collection 1974200, all Malmöhus church records — browse-only
- ArkivDigital (arkivdigital.se): subscription; best interface for Malmöhus church books
- Riksarkivet/SVAR (sok.riksarkivet.se): national archives digital reading room
- NAD (sok.riksarkivet.se/nad): finding aid for all Swedish archives
- Ancestry 'Sweden, Church Records, 1451–1943' (coll. 2225): subscription

- All Barsebäck FS volumes: 0% indexed, not full-text searchable — browse image-by-image in Swedish Gothic script
- Elena's patronym reveals father = Asmund; search for 'daughter of Asmund' c. 1683–1698
- Hofterup parish shares volumes with Barsebäck; check both
- 1696–1729 husförhörslängd covers exactly the years Elena would appear as household member
- Neighboring parishes: Hofterup, Råby, Flädie, Vallkärra, Lackalänga (Harjager härad)

## Locality Guide: Barsebäck Parish, Harjager, Malmöhus, Sweden — c. 1680–1740

### Jurisdictional context
Barsebäck is a Lutheran parish in Harjager hundred (*härad*), Malmöhus County, in the province of Scania (*Skåne*) — the southernmost region of Sweden. Standard historical place: **Barsebäck, Harjager, Malmöhus, Sweden** (in force 1648–1996; became "Barsebäck, Skåne, Sweden" after the 1997 county reform). Skåne was under Danish control until the Treaty of Roskilde (1658); by 1680 the Swedish Church of Sweden had full administrative control. The target period 1680–1740 is entirely within the Swedish ecclesiastical system, so records go through the Landsarkivet i Lund (Regional Archives of Lund), now part of Riksarkivet.

### Record types and availability

#### 1. Dopbok / Födelsebok (Baptism register)
- **Primary source for Elena's birth.** Records baptism date, child's name, father's name, mother's name, sometimes godparents.
- **FamilySearch:** "Sweden, Malmöhus, Church Records, 1541–1918; index 1646–1860" (collection 1974200). **1,639,027 images; 0 indexed records — browse-only.** Three digitized volumes for Barsebäck under imageGroupPrefix **004514823** (157, 428, and 164 images) cover 1648–1861.
- **Also in:** "Sweden, Baptisms, 1611–1920" (collection 1520594; 7 million indexed records) — worth name-searching, though Malmöhus indexing is sparse for this early period.

#### 2. Husförhörslängd (Household examination roll)
- **Highest-value source.** Clergy annually examined each household's knowledge of the catechism and recorded all household members, birth years, birthplaces, and moves in/out. For 1680–1740 these rolls give family composition and may record Elena's birth year and parish of origin directly.
- **FamilySearch:** Browse-only volumes under imageGroupPrefix **004514824** (258, 257, and 28 images) cover Barsebäck and Hofterup, 1696–1729 — spanning exactly the years when Elena would have appeared as a household member or young wife.
- Also within collection 1974200 (browse-only).

#### 3. Vigselbok (Marriage register)
- Would record Elena's marriage to Jöns Jönsson, providing her father's name and home parish.
- **FamilySearch:** "Sweden, Marriages, 1630–1920" (collection 1520596; 1.7 million indexed records); browse-only images in collection 1974200.

#### 4. Begravningsbok / Dödbok (Burial/death register)
- May record Elena's death with age and birthplace (if she survived long enough and died in Barsebäck).
- **FamilySearch:** "Sweden, Burials, 1649–1920" (collection 1520597; 1.16 million indexed records); browse-only images in collection 1974200.

#### 5. Inflyttnings- / Utflyttningslängd (In/out migration registers)
- If Elena moved into Barsebäck from another parish before her marriage, an inflyttningslängd entry would name her origin parish — this directly answers the birthplace question.
- Within the same browse-only image volumes (collection 1974200).

### Access and repositories

| FamilySearch (familysearch.org) | Free (login) | Browse-only for Malmöhus; collection 1974200 |
| ArkivDigital (arkivdigital.se / .net) | Subscription | Likely best digital scans of Malmöhus church books; worth subscribing or using institutional access |

### Quirks and search strategy
- **All Barsebäck volumes on FamilySearch are 0% name-indexed and not full-text searchable** — every search requires browsing image-by-image in Swedish (older *fraktur*/Gothic hand). Plan for direct image reading.
- **Elena's patronym "Asmundsdotter" reveals her father's given name: Asmund** — a relatively uncommon Scandinavian name. Search baptism registers for a daughter of "Asmund [surname]" in Barsebäck or neighboring Hofterup c. 1683–1698 (if Elena was 20–35 at the 1718 baptism).
- **Hofterup parish** shares digitized volumes with Barsebäck (imageGroupPrefix 004514824, 1696–1729). Elena or her parents may appear there; check both parishes together.
- **Skåne was Danish before 1658:** if Elena's parents were born pre-1658, look to Danish-era records. Swedish Church records in Barsebäck run from 1648 onward.
- **Language:** Records are in Swedish, written in older Swedish Gothic script (*äldre svenska*/*fraktur*). Some Latin appears in early entries.
- **ArkivDigital** is the leading Swedish subscription service for browsing church books online; it often has better image quality and a faster browsing interface than FamilySearch for Malmöhus material.
- **Neighboring parishes to check if Barsebäck yields nothing:** Hofterup, Råby, Flädie, Vallkärra, Lackalänga (all in Harjager härad).
